purpose: First use of six preselected real positive controls after freezing v2; small purpose-selected pilot, not population validation.
selection: Exact-name VSX identity query, closest TIC within 10 arcsec with position recorded, earliest/latest non-fast SPOC sectors; retain all unavailable targets. Reject overlapping TIC with previous runs/known controls. No photometry examined in selection.
evaluation: Freeze algorithm before analyzing any of these light curves. Labels and catalog periods are used only after predictions. Do not tune v2 against these outcomes.
missing_negative_evidence: No unlabeled star may be assumed constant. This pilot cannot certify real false-positive rate.
